_readme: The Barred Gate's theme. NOTES, not samples: this is performed by the same synthesiser
the cues are, so the three shipped voices give three renditions of one tune the way
three sprite styles draw one rig. dusk16 plays it on a triangle pitched down; gb16 plays
it as a bit-crushed square. Not one note below changes.
A voice is an array of BARS and a bar is a string of tokens, because that is how a map's
ground is written here and for the same reason: it lines up in a diff, and a wrong note
is a wrong column rather than a wrong line of JSON.
A token is <note><octave>:<steps>, '-:<steps>' for a rest, or 'x:<steps>' for a hit on a
noise instrument. Steps are sixteenths, so a 4/4 bar is 16 of them and every bar must
add to EXACTLY that - a bar that does not is rendered short and every later bar walks
off the beat, which sounds like a bug in the synthesiser rather than a typo in a string.
Sharps only. Two spellings of one pitch is two ways to write one file.
Eight seconds is 345 KB per voice once rendered, and this repo commits three. Length is
the whole cost of music here, which is why MusicTrack refuses a track past MAX_SECONDS
rather than trusting the next one to be reasonable.
It is in A minor, which is the key with no sharps in it - so the tune reads as written.
